name: Emma Lozano
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 7A

items.text: Emma Lozano is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member for District 7A, covering Little Village, Pilsen and the Near West Side. She is a pastor and founder of Centro Sin Fronteras. She is a former English as a second language teacher. She is a trustee of the Chicago Teachers' Pension Fund.

sentences.text: Emma Lozano is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member for District 7A, covering Little Village, Pilsen and the Near West Side.
She is a pastor and founder of Centro Sin Fronteras.
She is a former English as a second language teacher.
She is a trustee of the Chicago Teachers' Pension Fund.

items.text: She has supported efforts to give English learners equal access to education and backed policies limiting Chicago Public Schools cooperation with federal immigration authorities. She voted for a budget that assumed $150 million in uncommitted state aid and supports raising taxes on the wealthy for school funding. She helped establish Rudy Lozano School and advocated for undocumented parents to vote in Local School Council elections.
